title: Yacht Finance Calculator
h1: Yacht Finance Calculator (title as shown in search result listing; H1 not separately revealed)
summary: Despite sitting under /case-studies/, the page is primarily a guide to yacht finance rather than a single-deal write-up. Per search [a], it 'describes the kind of calculator it's meant to host rather than showing working numbers': the calculator is meant to help a buyer see whether their monthly budget fits the monthly payments required to purchase a yacht of a particular size or price. It describes two loan structures: a standard yacht mortgage (roughly 5 to 7 years with a balloon payment of about 25% of the loan) and a lease (works more like car finance or hire purchase). It says the tools can also be used for purchases in France, Italy and Spain or anywhere in the Mediterranean, and that Silver Oak Capital has financed a number of yachts for French and Italian high net worth individuals who spend most of their time on their yachts in places like Monaco, St Tropez and Portofino. Search [b] attributes to the page one worked deal: a GBP 6 million facility at 70% loan-to-value, 3.5% fixed rate, 60-month term, quarterly repayments with a 20% balloon, and six months of interest held on deposit; the borrower had irregular income and Eastern European commodities wealth, and the firm 'arranged 6 months interest cover to be placed on account with the yacht finance lender' to reassure the lender. Asset make/model, yacht size, lender identity, timing to completion and exit are NOT revealed in the results. Neither search confirmed whether a working calculator widget is present on the live page.
